title: Twelve Chapters on the Faith
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Opera omnia, Greek and Latin (Paris, 1622), Latin column (Duodecim Capita de Fide): Capita I-XII; Greek column OCR damaged
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Twelve Chapters on the Faith, in a fresh English translation: twelve brief condemnations of false teaching about Christ, each with a short explanation, ending with praise of the Father and the Holy Spirit and a warning against quarrels over words.
era_note: The Twelve Chapters on the Faith stand under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name in the third-century Neocaesarean tradition; later Latin presentation is disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Crombie, PD); this is a fresh English translation of all twelve chapters from the Latin.

text_history.method: English translated from the Latin column of the Opera omnia print (Paris, 1622) for all twelve chapters; Chapters III-XII were read from the page images (printed pp. 3-8, PDF pp. 27-32). The facing Greek column was checked on the page images at doubtful places; its OCR is too damaged to lock. Vossius's scholia are left out; marginal variants are noted, not adopted. In Chapter IX the print reads 'corruptible in flesh' where its margin gives 'incorruptible'; the printed reading is translated. ANF 6 was consulted only as a sense check for Chapters I-II.

witnesses.name: Opera omnia, Greek and Latin (Paris: Sonnius, Morel and Cramoisy, 1622), page images
witnesses.coverage: Capita I-XII (Chapters III-XII read from the page images, printed pp. 3-8)

joins.note: OCR of clavorum / lancea / palpandum / clausis ianuis restored from the facing column and the John 20 scene; not invented doctrine.
